node.title: Rank-eleven factor-flag two-threshold residual route wall
node.closure: an intermediate ordered-basis residual-flat band cannot improve the 18166-coordinate factor-flag output
node.statement: Inside the exact 2 x 5 factor-flag router, refine residual transversality h by an emitted-flat threshold S. If S>=18167 and h<=S-2, greedy completion from one intermediate rich-flat label adds dimension-two and dimension-three class terms. Their denominators are at most 7426405419526 and 368352056, forcing at least 187184 and 3381 classes. Their R_4/R_6 charge is 66303977459889028, over the complete residual allowance by 1136007786173558 before factor or transverse costs. If h=S-1 the intermediate band is empty and the parent all-cutoff scan gives S<=18166. This is a charge-family wall, not a mathematical obstruction to coupled algebraic routes.
